ops.oldText: Notwithstanding the foregoing, Customer may assign this Agreement to a successor organization by merger, consolidation or acquisition.
ops.newText: Notwithstanding the foregoing, Customer may assign this Agreement, without IBM's consent, to an Affiliate or to a successor organization by merger, consolidation, acquisition or sale of substantially all of its assets. IBM will not assign this Agreement or any of its rights hereunder without Customer's prior written consent, such consent not to be unreasonably withheld, and in no event to a competitor of Customer.

input.comment: [Playbook] We have made the assignment provision reciprocal: IBM's assignment now requires our consent (not unreasonably withheld) and cannot be to our competitor, and we have added the standard affiliate/asset-sale carve-out to our side. Our playbook requires at least mutual assignment rights, and as drafted only we were restricted.
input.summary: Make § 14.10 mutual: add affiliate/asset-sale carve-out for Customer and a consent requirement on IBM assignment.
